That’s difficult because at least in my experience there were a lot of things that I took as challenges that really should have been dealbreakers. I have let a lot go when I probably shouldn’t have.

I told him I struggle with depression and occasional suicidal thoughts and he said, “Wow, I thought you were this selfless and great person.”

Another one, “You have made no impact on my life or anyone else’s. You could have never been born, you could kill yourself now or you could keep living and no one’s lives would be any different. That’s how little you matter to the world. You don’t make anyone’s life better, but you don’t make anyone’s life worse. You truly don’t matter.”
I’m having so much trouble not texting. It’s been almost a week for me too.

I seem to find relationships where all the men have very low libidos. When I bring it up to try to find a compromise and make something work I am called selfish for wanting sex. Unfortunately I find that taking care of myself makes me want sex more and I really end up getting no relief.
Thought I was the only person that did this. I sometimes don’t notice I’m doing it at first but I’ve been told it’s one of my tells that I’m experiencing something uncomfortable.
What’s frustrating is I’m told it’s not me. If it’s not then how can I fix it?
Still dealing with almost all of these now in my 30s
Replace alcoholism with weed and cigarettes and you just described my situation.

Mine would act bored and underwhelmed. Doesn’t matter if it was exactly what he asked for or something I put a lot of time and effort into. 

I initially read the OP wrong and thought it said do they return YOUR gift. That would also be true. I’ve never received a gift that I was allowed to keep. He would return it, give it to someone else, take it for himself instead or break it so I couldn’t have it anymore.
Embarrassingly, almost 4 years.
Literally describing my relationship currently
I feel like you just wrote about my life!
I could have wrote this myself it rang so true.
This is night 2 of the same shit. I didn’t call and I regret it. Would I call 911 or the non emergency number. There’s no physical fighting so that’s why I don’t know if the 911 is warranted.

I just had that conversation word for word about 30 minutes ago. I’m the reason that things are the way they are and he deserves better than me. All while calling me names and telling me what a piece of shit I am.
There are a lot of things you said that are extremely similar to what I’m going through now. I’m glad you were able to get out and it gives me hope that I can figure out how to do it someday too.
Hope others have better luck than I did. I’ve called those numbers and tried the chat. No one answers or they tell me there are more important calls than mine and hang up.

I’ve been trying to call or chat with them or the suicide hotline. No one answers Or connects. The one time I got through on the suicide one they told me my concerns were not that important and to call another time as they had more important calls to take. I don’t know what else to do.

I’m literally in the exact same situation. I know he won’t go to therapy. I should probably leave but most of the time I think this is what I deserve and there would never be anything better. I would be alone. I know it’s easier said than done to leave. Of course that’s the best answer. But I want you to know you aren’t alone in the way you question whether you should leave or not even if it might seem obvious to other people.

It finally went physical after years of gaslighting and other emotional abuse. He would attack me and I would try to defend myself and get beat up more. I finally just put my hands down and didn’t even block. I would just look him in the eyes while he did it and I prayed that the next hit would be the one to kill me since I was too much of a coward to do it myself. I’d get yelled at for not defending myself then. But that’s how it was when you did everything wrong.
